There were no Discussion Items.

D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director announced that the Annual Tree Lighting Event will be held December 1, 2023.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, reported that earlier in the fall, there were a number of bills that were passed and has been
working with staff to address those laws, mostly going into effect January 1, 2024.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the Turkey Bowl at Fedde Middle School.

Councilmember De Paula reported that he attended the flag football league banquet, and thanked the neighborhood
counselor for putting it together.

Councilmember Vargas thanked the neighborhood counselor.

Mayor Del Rio reported that she attended the flag football banquet, and thanked all staff members involved with the event.
